title: Photo-Darlington optocoupler (GaAs infrared LED + NPN Darlington)

sources.document: Texas Instruments, The Optoelectronics Data Book for Design Engineers 5th ed. 1978, TIL113/TIL119 opto-couplers (bulletin DL-S 12032, rev. Oct 1978)

functions.text: Current through the LED turns the Darlington phototransistor on: collector current at least 30 mA at IF 10 mA, VCE 1 V (300% minimum transfer ratio). LED forward voltage 1.5 V max at 10 mA. VCE(sat) 1 V max at IC 125 mA, IF 50 mA. Dark current 100 nA max at VCE 10 V.

electrical.notes: Limits: input-output 1.5 kV; VCEO 30 V, VCBO 30 V, VEBO 7 V, VECO 7 V; LED IF 100 mA, VR 3 V. outputMaxVoltageV = VCEO.

timing.conditions: VCC 15 V, IC(on) 125 mA, RL 100 ohm, TA 25 C
VCC 15 V, IC(on) 125 mA, RL 100 ohm, TA 25 C

unknown: Rise/fall time printed once per row (300 us); read as typical.
The electrical table text layer mixes the TIL113 and TIL119 columns; the 30 mA on-state minimum is supported by the "300% minimum at 10 mA" feature line.
